definitions.gloss: during that time; meanwhile; in the meantime
definitions.explanation: refers to the period of time while something else is happening

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}している。その{間|あいだ}、{待|ま}っていてね。
examples.english: I'm on the phone. Wait for me in the meantime.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}が{出来|でき}るまで{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}かかる。その{間|あいだ}に{掃除|そうじ}をしよう。
examples.english: The cooking will take 30 minutes. Let's clean in the meantime.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{海外|かいがい}にいた。その{間|あいだ}、{私|わたし}が{仕事|しごと}を{引|ひ}き{継|つ}いだ。
examples.english: He was overseas. During that time, I took over his work.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
その (that) + {間|あいだ} (interval, between)

PRONUNCIATION:
- その{間|あいだ} - standard reading
- その{間|かん} - more formal/literary

USAGE:
- その{間|あいだ}に - during that time (for doing something else)
- その{間|あいだ} - meanwhile (standalone)

COMMON PATTERNS:
その + noun pattern:
- そのため - therefore
- その{後|ご} - after that
- その{前|まえ} - before that
- その{時|とき} - at that time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- その{間|あいだ}に - during that time
- {一方|いっぽう} - meanwhile, on the other hand
- それまで - until then
